# Moorish Tour

> Local Morocco travel agency offering private tours, guided itineraries, and Sahara Desert experiences.

Moorish Tour helps travelers plan Morocco trips, including Marrakech desert tours, Morocco multi-day journeys, and experiences around Merzouga. Find verified trip pages, local advice, and direct contact information below.

## Main pages

- [About Moorish Tour](https://moorishtour.com/about/): Meet our local Morocco travel team.
- [Contact Moorish Tour](https://moorishtour.com/contact/): Request help planning and booking a Morocco trip.
- [All Morocco tours](https://moorishtour.com/tour/): Explore desert tours and multi-day Morocco itineraries.
- [Morocco travel blog](https://moorishtour.com/blog/): Browse destination guides and practical travel advice.
- [Morocco travel activities](https://moorishtour.com/activity/): Learn about camel treks, quad biking and local experiences.

## Tours and activities

- [Marrakech to Merzouga desert tour](https://moorishtour.com/tour/3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga/): Three-day itinerary from Marrakech to the Sahara.
- [Ten-day Morocco tour from Tangier](https://moorishtour.com/tour/10-days-in-morocco-tour-from-tangier/): Travel itinerary starting in Tangier.
- [Morocco desert camel trekking](https://moorishtour.com/activity/camel-trekking-in-the-desert/): Camel trekking in the Sahara desert.
- [Quad biking in Morocco](https://moorishtour.com/activity/quad-biking-in-marrakech-and-merzouga/): Quad biking experiences near Marrakech and Merzouga.
